item.description:
SPICY VODKA CHICKEN PARM SANDWICH For the chicken cutlets: -Chicken breasts -Panko breadcrumbs (plus a little Italian breadcrumbs, optional) -Parmigiano Reggiano -Dried oregano -Eggs -All purpose flour -Salt -Black pepper -Oil for frying For the spicy vodka sauce: -Shallots -Garlic -Calabrian chilies or red pepper flakes -Tomato paste -Vodka -Passata -Heavy cream -Cold unsalted butter -Parmigiano -Olive oil -Salt -Black pepper For assembly: -1 long ciabatta or good quality baguette -Low moisture mozzarella -Fresh basil or pesto
